items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Each change is a short `if not ...is_cached(rel_obj):` guard that matches the existing style, and the field cache API makes the intent clear. Nothing needed extra comments.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The same is_cached guard is copied into 7 places (__get__, __set__, get_prefetch_queryset in three descriptors), but only the reverse-FK get_prefetch_queryset spot needed it. That widens the behavior change beyond the minimal fix.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The __set__ guards (`if value is not None and not remote_field.multiple and not remote_field.is_cached(value)`) can leave a stale reverse cache: reassigning `new_profile.user = u` no longer updates u.profile if u already has a cached one.

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The reverse-FK path is guarded with `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj): setattr(...)`, and ReverseOneToOneDescriptor.get_prefetch_queryset gets the same guard. Plain prefetches still populate the cache.
